## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 571 reads during 450 rostered hours. This represents an average output of 1.3 per hour. The workload record provides a clear basis for considering both the volume completed and the time available for the work. It also supports comparison with the quality checks undertaken during the review period.

## Quality

A sample of 48 reads was checked. The recorded agreement was 56.2 per cent. These checks included borderline background cases, allowing the review to consider work requiring closer judgement as well as routine decisions. Feedback was provided on those borderline background cases to support consistency in future grading.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
